public.course_assets.name: course admins manage asset metadata
public.course_assets.using: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "b_public__profiles" p WHERE p.id=$UID AND p.role='admin' AND p.status='active')
public.course_assets.check: (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "b_public__profiles" p WHERE p.id=$UID AND p.role='admin' AND p.status='active') AND (uploaded_by = $UID))

public.course_assets.name: students read published asset metadata
public.course_assets.using: ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "b_public__courses" c WHERE ((c.id = __row.course_id) AND (c.status = 'published')))) AND ((block_id IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "b_public__course_blocks" b JOIN "b_public__course_lessons" l ON l.id=b.lesson_id JOIN "b_public__course_modules" m ON m.id=l.module_id JOIN "b_public__course_chapters" ch ON ch.id=m.chapter_id JOIN "b_public__courses" c ON c.id=ch.course_id WHERE b.id=__row.block_id AND c.status='published' AND m.status='published' AND l.status='published')))
